findings.title: Reflected XSS via HTML response
findings.message: Unescaped template interpolation (<%- or {{{) can produce XSS.
findings.remediation: Reflected XSS via HTML response. See https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/79.html

findings.title: Open redirect
findings.message: Tainted input is passed to res.redirect.
findings.remediation: Open redirect. See https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/601.html

findings.title: Express app does not use helmet
findings.message: An Express app is created but helmet() is never applied.
findings.remediation: Add app.use(helmet()) to set standard security headers.

findings.title: Hardcoded express-session secret
findings.message: Hardcoded express-session secret (shhh****).
findings.remediation: Rotate this credential immediately, then load it from an environment variable or a secret manager. Removing it from the code is NOT enough: it remains visible in git history.

findings.title: Auth route without a rate limiter
findings.message: Route /login looks like an auth endpoint and has no rate limiter.
findings.remediation: Apply express-rate-limit (or similar) to login/auth routes.
